cases.d: Verify the roster requires sign-in, hides the meeting from outsiders and reports read and write failures.
steps: Send GET /api/meetings/<id>/participants without authentication.
Send it as an outsider who is not on the roster.
Stop PostgreSQL and send it as the meeting Secretary.
Restart PostgreSQL; as the Secretary send POST /api/meetings/<id>/participants with { "userIds": ["<outsider id>"], "role": "Member" } and no If-Match header.
exp: Anonymous: HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
Outsider: HTTP 404 Not Found.
Read failure: HTTP 500 with code "MSG95" ("Không tải được danh sách thành phần hoặc phản hồi lời mời.").
Missing If-Match: HTTP 400 with code "MSG276".
pre: A Published meeting has an organizer, a Chair, a Secretary and a Member.
An active outsider account exists.

cases.d: Verify each meeting status allows reading, managing and responding as the state matrix says.
steps: For each status Draft, WaitingApproval, Rejected, Approved, Published, InProgress, Ended: as the Secretary and the Chair, send GET /api/meetings/<id>/participants.
As the Secretary, add the outsider as Member (POST /participants with the current If-Match).
As the Member, send PUT /api/meetings/<id>/invitation-response with { "response": "Accepted" }.
exp: Reading the roster returns HTTP 200 OK for the Secretary and the Chair in every status.
Adding returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG96" in Draft, Rejected, Approved, Published and InProgress, and HTTP 409 with code "MSG98" in WaitingApproval and Ended.
Responding is allowed only in Published, InProgress and Ended; otherwise it is refused.
pre: One meeting per status exists with an organizer, a Chair, a Secretary and a Member.

cases.d: Verify a meeting creator can find active people and create a meeting without AdminUsers.
steps: Sign in as an account whose role has only MeetingCreator.
Send GET /api/meetings/participant-options?q=<part of a name>.
Create a meeting with POST /api/meetings using one of the returned people as Chair.
exp: The lookup returns HTTP 200 OK with active people only.
The meeting is created with HTTP 201 and code "MSG29".
pre: A role with only MeetingCreator exists and is held by the tester's account.

cases.d: Verify a batch add is all-or-nothing and guest emails are compared without case.
steps: As the Secretary, POST /participants with { "userIds": ["<outsider id>", "<random UUID>"], "role": "Member" }.
POST /participants with { "userIds": ["<outsider id>"], "role": "Member", "additionalPermissions": ["AdminUsers"] }.
POST /guest-invitations with { "invitedName": "Khách", "email": "Case@example.test" }.
POST /guest-invitations again with "email": "case@EXAMPLE.test".
exp: The first two requests return HTTP 400 with code "MSG97" and add nobody.
The first guest invitation returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG96".
The second is refused with code "MSG97" as the same email.
pre: A Draft meeting with its Secretary signed in; each write sends If-Match with the current roster revision.

cases.d: Verify an internal invitee whose email matches a current guest is refused on userIds.
steps: As the Secretary, invite guest duplicate@guests.test (POST /guest-invitations).
Change the outsider's email to DUPLICATE@guests.test.
POST /participants with { "userIds": ["<outsider id>"], "role": "Member" } and the current If-Match.
exp: The guest invitation returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG96".
The add returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG97" and an error under userIds.
pre: A Draft meeting with its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify two simultaneous adds with the same revision store one assignment.
steps: In two Postman tabs signed in as the Secretary, prepare POST /participants with { "userIds": ["<outsider id>"], "role": "Member" } and the same If-Match.
Send both at the same time (Postman runner, 2 parallel requests).
exp: One request returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG96".
The other returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG275" ("Danh sách thành phần đã thay đổi. Vui lòng tải lại và thử lại.").
The outsider appears once on the roster and receives one invitation.
pre: A Draft meeting with its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify removing and re-inviting keeps the history and revokes the meeting and agenda access.
steps: As the Member, decline the invitation (PUT /invitation-response { "response": "Declined" }).
As the Secretary, DELETE /api/meetings/<id>/participants/<member participant id>.
As the Member, GET the meeting, GET its agenda and PUT a response again.
As the Secretary, add the Member again.
exp: Decline returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG105"; remove returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG103" ("Gỡ thành phần tham dự thành công.").
After removal the Member gets HTTP 404 for the meeting, the agenda and the response.
Re-inviting creates a new seat; the earlier decline stays in the history.
pre: A Published meeting with the Member invited.

cases.d: Verify the last Secretary cannot be removed but can be swapped atomically.
steps: As the Secretary, DELETE /participants/<secretary participant id>.
PUT /participants/assignments with { "changes": [{ "participantId": "<secretary participant id>", "role": "Member" }, { "participantId": "<member participant id>", "role": "Secretary" }] }.
exp: The removal returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG109" ("Cuộc họp phải giữ Chủ tọa và Thư ký theo quy định. Hãy phân công người thay thế.").
The swap returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG100" ("Cập nhật vai trò cuộc họp thành công.").
The roster still loads.
pre: A meeting with exactly one Secretary and one Member.

cases.d: Verify a Chair replacement needs confirmation and both roles roll back if the second save fails.
steps: As the Chair, PUT /participants/assignments swapping Chair and Member without chairReplacement.
Send it again with "chairReplacement": { "outgoingParticipantId": "<chair id>", "incomingParticipantId": "<member id>", "confirmed": true } while the database fails on the second save.
Send it once more with the database available.
exp: Without confirmation: HTTP 400 with code "MSG101".
On the save failure: HTTP 503 with code "MSG102"; neither role changed.
Retry: success; the Member is Chair.
pre: A Published meeting with a Chair and a Member.

cases.d: Verify an inactive Chair can only be demoted through a confirmed replacement by an active member.
steps: Deactivate the Chair's account.
As the Secretary, PUT /participants/assignments swapping Chair and Member without confirmation.
Send it with the confirmed chairReplacement.
exp: Without confirmation: HTTP 400 with code "MSG101".
With confirmation: HTTP 200; the active Member is Chair and the old Chair is Member.
pre: A Published or InProgress meeting with a Chair, a Secretary and a Member.

cases.d: Verify an inactive Secretary loses management rights and a chunked body is limited.
steps: Deactivate the Secretary.
As the organizer, GET /participant-context.
As the deactivated Secretary, GET /participants.
As the organizer, send a write with a body over 64 KiB in chunks.
exp: canManageParticipants is false.
The deactivated Secretary gets HTTP 403 Forbidden.
The oversized write is refused (HTTP 413 with code "MSG87" or 405 for an unsupported method).
pre: An Approved meeting with organizer and Secretary.

cases.d: Verify a participant answers their own invitation without changing attendance.
steps: As the Member, PUT /invitation-response with { "response": "Accepted" }.
Send the same answer again.
Send { "response": "Delegated" }.
exp: First: HTTP 200 with code "MSG105" ("Đã ghi nhận phản hồi lời mời.").
Repeat: HTTP 200 with code "MSG154" ("Không có thay đổi cần lưu.").
Delegated: HTTP 400 with code "MSG106".
The response is Accepted; attendance is unchanged.
pre: A Published meeting with the Member invited.

cases.d: Verify an answered invitation can be changed and a repeated answer is a no-op, for members and guests.
steps: As the Member, GET /invitation-response, then PUT { "response": "Accepted" } and repeat it.
Repeat with Declined.
Repeat the same steps as an invited guest.
exp: canRespond is true before answering.
The first answer returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG105"; the repeat returns code "MSG154".
The saved answer is visible to readers of the roster.
pre: A Published meeting with the Member and a guest invited.

cases.d: Verify the response is asked once and never of the Chair.
steps: As the Member, GET /api/meetings/<id>.
As the Chair, GET /api/meetings/<id> and GET /participant-context.
As the Chair, PUT /invitation-response with { "response": "Accepted" }.
exp: The Member sees canRespond true and myResponse null.
The Chair sees canRespond false in both places.
The Chair's PUT is refused.
pre: A Published meeting with a Chair and a Member.

cases.d: Verify a declined meeting leaves only the decliner's calendar.
steps: As the Member, GET /api/meetings?pageSize=100&excludeDeclined=true.
Decline the invitation.
Repeat the list request as the Member and as the Secretary.
exp: Before declining, the meeting is listed for the Member with canRespond true.
After declining, it is gone from the Member's excludeDeclined list.
It is still in the Secretary's list.
pre: A Published meeting with the Member and a Secretary.

cases.d: Verify the response body is strict.
steps: As the Member, PUT /invitation-response with Content-Type: text/plain and body {}.
Send { "response": "Accepted", "response": "Declined" }.
Send { "response": "Accepted", "userId": "spoof" }.
Send { "Response": "Accepted" }.
exp: text/plain: HTTP 415 with code "MSG34".
Each of the other bodies: HTTP 400 with code "MSG106".
No answer is saved.
pre: A Published meeting with the Member invited.

cases.d: Verify a guest needs a verified, current session and never gets internal roles.
steps: As the Secretary, POST /guest-invitations with { "invitedName": "Khách", "email": "guest@example.test" }.
As the guest with a verified session, GET /participants.
Repeat with an unverified session, an expired session and a session mixed with an internal user.
exp: The invitation returns HTTP 201 with code "MSG96" and createdIds.
The verified guest reads the roster (HTTP 200).
The other sessions are refused.
The guest can never be given Chair, Secretary or Member.
pre: A Published meeting with its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify guest sessions are independent and the self-declared profile does not replace the invitation.
steps: Invite guest "Tên trên lời mời" (identity@example.test).
As the guest, fill the profile "Tên tự khai", "Chức danh tự khai".
Open a second guest session and read the roster.
exp: The roster still shows the invited name from the invitation as evidence.
Each session is separate; ending one does not end the other.
pre: A Published meeting with its Secretary signed in.

cases.d: Verify chair handover candidates are filtered before search and paging.
steps: As the Chair, GET /participants/chair-handover-candidates?q=same&page=1&pageSize=1.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
Only current, active, non-delegated internal Members of this meeting are offered; inactive, removed, delegated, guest and other-meeting people are not.
total counts after search and before paging.
pre: A Published meeting whose roster includes six extra users: two named "same", one inactive, one removed, one delegated, one guest.

cases.d: Verify no eligible member is a successful empty answer with no side effects.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the meeting Chair>

exp: HTTP 200 OK response with code "MSG258".
items is empty; total and eligibleTotal are 0.
Nothing is changed.
pre: A Published meeting whose only Member has been deactivated.

cases.d: Verify the status is checked before the input.
steps: For a Draft, WaitingApproval, Rejected, Approved and Ended meeting: as the Chair, GET /chair-handover-candidates?unknown=x and POST /chair-handover with { "invalid": true }.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG260" ("Bạn không còn quyền giao vai trò Chủ tọa ...").
pre: Meetings in those statuses with the same Chair.

cases.d: Verify only the current Chair can hand over and others learn nothing.
steps: Send GET /chair-handover-candidates?bad=1 and POST /chair-handover as: anonymous, an outsider, the Member, the Secretary and the organizer.
exp: Anonymous: HTTP 401.
Outsider: HTTP 404 with an empty body.
Member, Secretary and organizer: HTTP 409 with code "MSG260".
pre: A Published meeting with Chair, Secretary, Member and organizer.

cases.d: Verify an invalid new Chair is reported before a stale revision.
steps: As the Chair, POST /chair-handover with an old If-Match and newChairParticipantId set to, in turn: the Chair, the Secretary, an inactive Member, a removed Member, an unknown id, a guest, a member of another meeting, a delegated Member.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG259" (the new Chair must be a current internal member), not 409 MSG275.
pre: A Published meeting with Chair, Secretary and Member.

cases.d: Verify the body is validated strictly before the If-Match header.
steps: As the Chair, POST /chair-handover without If-Match with each body: {, null, [], {}, newChairParticipantId null, "bad", the all-zero UUID, without confirmed, confirmed false, confirmed null.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG101".
Nothing changes.
pre: A Published meeting with Chair and Member.

cases.d: Verify body, media type and size errors come before an unknown query parameter.
steps: As the Chair, POST /chair-handover?unexpected=1 with: body {; a body with confirmed false; Content-Type text/plain; a body of 65 537 bytes.
exp: Invalid JSON and missing confirmation: HTTP 400 with code "MSG101".
text/plain: HTTP 415 with code "MSG34".
Oversized: HTTP 413 with code "MSG87" ("Nội dung JSON vượt quá 64 KiB.").
pre: A Published meeting with Chair and Member.

cases.d: Verify the query string is validated strictly.
steps: As the Chair, GET /chair-handover-candidates and POST /chair-handover with each query: ?page=0, ?page=-1, ?page=abc, ?page=1&page=2, ?pageSize=0, ?pageSize=101, ?unknown=1, ?Page=1, ?q=x&q=y.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG276" ("Query hoặc If-Match không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại dữ liệu.").
pre: A Published meeting with Chair and Member.

cases.d: Verify the If-Match header, media type, length and query limits are enforced.
steps: POST /chair-handover with If-Match missing, *, participants-0, W/"participants-0", "participants--1" and two tags.
GET candidates with q of 201 characters.
POST with a body that is not JSON, then with a body over 64 KiB.
exp: Each bad If-Match and the long q return HTTP 400 with code "MSG276".
Non-JSON returns HTTP 415 with code "MSG34".
Oversized returns HTTP 413 with code "MSG87".
pre: A Published meeting with Chair and Member.

cases.d: Verify a missing Secretary blocks the handover and a read failure returns MSG95.
steps: Change the Secretary's seat to Member, then POST /chair-handover as the Chair.
Stop PostgreSQL and GET /chair-handover-candidates.
exp: The handover returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG109"; nothing changes.
The read returns HTTP 500 with code "MSG95".
pre: A Published meeting with Chair, Secretary and Member.

cases.d: Verify a handover keeps the evidence and commits one set of side effects.
steps: As the Chair, POST /chair-handover with { "newChairParticipantId": "<member participant id>", "confirmed": true } and the current If-Match.
exp: HTTP 200 OK with code "MSG257" ("Giao vai trò Chủ tọa thành công.").
The Member is Chair and the old Chair is Member.
Earlier answers, attendance and votes are unchanged.
One notification and one invitation are created for each change, no more.
pre: A Published or InProgress meeting where both people already answered, attendance was recorded and a vote exists.

cases.d: Verify a failure at either save rolls back roles, revision and all side effects.
steps: Make the database fail on the first save, POST the handover; repeat failing on the second save.
POST the handover again with the database healthy.
exp: Each failing request returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG102"; roles, revision, notifications and invitations are unchanged.
The retry returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG257".
pre: A Published meeting with Chair, Secretary and Member.

cases.d: Verify a transport failure after commit does not report a false save failure.
steps: Interrupt the realtime broadcast after the commit, then POST the handover.
POST the same handover again.
exp: The first request returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG257"; the Member is Chair and two invitation dispatches exist.
The second returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG260" because the caller is no longer Chair.
pre: A Published meeting with Chair, Secretary and Member.
